galleryPaint.reason: Intermittent blank offscreen content-visibility:auto paint after reflow
galleryPaint.resolution: Screenshot-only content-visibility:visible, no masks or geometry overrides

captionBug.reason: Fully painted captions extended beyond fixed-height justified items
captionBug.resolution: Keep fixed height on image links; allow item height to include caption flow
captionBug.assertion: Browser caption bottom <= owning item bottom + 1 at text spacing and actual zoom

typeSpecimen.reason: Unbroken alphabet at text spacing overflowed by 10px
typeSpecimen.resolution: Use existing specimen stress wrapping class

rtlBug.reason: Lower-specificity RTL animation-name lost to checked-state animation shorthand; adjacent groups moved left out of the viewport
rtlBug.resolution: Inherited animation name selected at ticker root
rtlBug.assertion: Both viewport edges covered and actual li content intersects viewport at start/mid/end in LTR/RTL

geometryPrecision.reason: Float precision in transformed DOMRects, below CSS layout quantum; screenshot changed-pixel allowance remains zero

cancellation.resolution: Runner-only IPC cancellation relay; leave inherited Playwright worker IPC untouched
cancellation.verification: Dedicated relay unit plus owned-bootstrap failure/abort cleanup probes
